item.title: STEM Toy Sourcing: Age Grading, Magnets and Test Scope
item.description: STEM is a marketing label, not a safety category. How building sets, science kits and coding robots differ in risk, where the age grade becomes a hard constraint, the magnet and chemistry rules, and how to make educational claims you can defend.
